‘Utopian’ city California Forever announces huge tech
manufacturing park 
California Forever announced on Thursday plans to
build a massive manufacturing park called Solano
Foundry, the newest addition to its master-planned
“utopian” city backed by a group of Silicon Valley
billionaires.
Solano Foundry is 2,100 acres that can host 40
million square feet of advanced tech
manufacturing space. The manufacturing park will
be built as part of its planned walkable city with
over 175,000 homes, CEO Jan Sramek said at the
Reindustrialize conference in Detroit.
Sramek tweeted that U.S. manufacturers can’t win
by “building factories off of random freeway exits in
the middle of nowhere. The best people don’t want
to work there.”
This site will offer expedited permitting,
transportation for finished goods, and plenty of
power from renewable energy, he said. The hope is
that it will attract hardware, engineering, and AI
talent from relatively nearby Silicon Valley. Solano
County is about 40 miles northeast of San
Francisco.
